# cache

ElastiCache Redis 7 replication group with encryption in transit and at rest, an AUTH token generated by Terraform and stored in Secrets Manager, and a parameter group tuned for a cache whose keys all carry a TTL.

## What it creates

- Subnet group in the isolated subnets.
- Parameter group `bowline-<env>-redis7` with `maxmemory-policy = volatile-lru`.
- Replication group `bowline-<env>-redis`: TLS required, at-rest encryption, AUTH token, daily snapshot kept for `snapshot_retention_limit` days.
- Secret `bowline/<env>/redis` with `auth_token`, `primary_endpoint`, `reader_endpoint`, `port` and `url`. The `url` is what the API reads as `REDIS_URL` (`rediss://` scheme, database 0).

## Sizing

| Environment | Node type          | Nodes | Failover | Multi-AZ |
|-------------|--------------------|-------|----------|----------|
| staging     | `cache.t4g.micro`  | 1     | no       | no       |
| prod        | `cache.t4g.small`  | 2     | yes      | yes      |

Bowline keeps only a 60-second principal cache, rate limiter buckets and lockout counters in Redis. Losing the whole cache means one burst of extra database reads and, in the worst case, an attacker's lockout counter resetting once. That is why staging runs a single node and why production stays on small instances.

## Rotating the AUTH token

`terraform apply -replace=module.cache.random_password.auth_token`. ElastiCache rotates with `auth_token_update_strategy = ROTATE`, which keeps the previous token valid until the next rotation, so redeploy the API afterwards and the old token retires on the following rotation. See `docs/RUNBOOK.md`.

## Inputs

| Name                          | Type         | Default            |
|-------------------------------|--------------|--------------------|
| `environment`                 | string       |                    |
| `subnet_ids`                  | list(string) |                    |
| `security_group_ids`          | list(string) |                    |
| `node_type`                   | string       | `cache.t4g.micro`  |
| `engine_version`              | string       | `7.1`              |
| `parameter_group_family`      | string       | `redis7`           |
| `num_cache_clusters`          | number       | `1`                |
| `automatic_failover_enabled`  | bool         | `false`            |
| `multi_az_enabled`            | bool         | `false`            |
| `snapshot_retention_limit`    | number       | `1`                |
| `kms_key_id`                  | string       | `null`             |
| `apply_immediately`           | bool         | `false`            |
| `secret_recovery_window_days` | number       | `7`                |
| `secrets_kms_key_id`          | string       | `null`             |
| `tags`                        | map(string)  | `{}`               |

## Outputs

`replication_group_id`, `primary_endpoint_address`, `reader_endpoint_address`, `port`, `secret_arn`, `secret_name`.
